title: garrya laurifolia subsp. macrophylla
intro: Garrya laurifolia subsp. macrophylla, commonly known as Silk Tassel Bush, is a plant species in the family Garryaceae, native to the western coast of North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Garrya laurifolia subsp. macrophylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
